title: Microsoft Purview DLP: restrict access to Fabric semantic models and lakehouses
summary: Hold: the restrict-access portal path skips documented policy-settings and rule-customization pages, as well as the Actions section. The rollout, opt-in default, licensing and billing descriptions are supported; the workspace PowerShell reference also needs its narrower capacity qualification.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Semantic-model DLP evaluation is skipped for publishing, republishing or refreshing initiated using service principal authentication.
claims.quote: DLP evaluation of the semantic model doesn't occur if either of the following is true: An account using service principal authentication initiates the event (publish, republish, on-demand refresh, scheduled refresh).

claims.claim: Semantic-model DLP evaluation is skipped when the model owner is a service principal.
claims.quote: DLP evaluation of the semantic model doesn't occur if either of the following is true: ... The semantic model owner is a service principal.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: DirectQuery and live-connection semantic models are unsupported.
claims.quote: DLP policies for Fabric aren't supported for ... semantic models that connect to their data source via DirectQuery or live connection.

claims.claim: Fabric DLP applies only to data in tables stored in Delta format.
claims.quote: DLP policies for Fabric apply only on data in tables stored in Delta format.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Advanced classifiers, including exact data match and trainable classifiers, are unsupported and return no matches.
claims.quote: Advanced classifiers, such as exact data match (EDM), trainable classifiers ... aren't supported by DLP for Fabric. If you select an advanced classifier in the condition of a policy, the policy returns no results

claims.claim: Other classifiers in the same policy can still return results.
claims.quote: Other classifiers specified in the policy return results if any.

claims.claim: Semantic models are evaluated automatically on publish, republish, on-demand refresh and scheduled refresh, with matching policy actions then taking place.
claims.quote: If it does, the policy's specified actions take place. ... DLP policies evaluate a semantic model whenever one of the following events occurs: Publish; Republish; On-demand refresh; Scheduled refresh

claims.claim: Lakehouses and other Fabric items are evaluated when their data changes.
claims.quote: DLP policies evaluate a Fabric item, such as a lakehouse, SQL database, or Mirrored database, when the data within it changes.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Fabric DLP is covered by the pay-as-you-go billing model.
claims.quote: Capabilities that use the pay-as-you-go billing model ... Microsoft Fabric ... Azure | Fabric | Supported item types | Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention

claims.claim: Billing charges for each day a policy covers an asset.

claims.claim: Assets in an in-scope location count even without matching the policy conditions.
claims.quote: The asset doesn't have to match a policy's conditions to be counted, it just has to be in a location that's in the scope of a policy.

claims.quote: A tenant has 10 Fabric workspaces, each with 50 assets. The policy only applies to five of these Fabric workspaces. The asset count for this policy is 250.

claims.claim: The displayed restrict-access creation path gives the complete documented sequence through the Purview portal.

claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui.path and the corresponding rendered path with 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Assign admin units > Fabric and Power BI workspaces > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > Actions > Restrict access or encrypt the content in Microsoft 365 locations'. Keep the existing note explaining naming, advancing without admin units and selecting the Block users option. The omitted Define policy settings and Customize advanced DLP rules pages and Actions section are explicitly documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/governance/data-loss-prevention-configure.
